limitations: The template is a generic benchmark topology with a competition landing-page citation, not a historical winning implementation.
Stage descriptions must be interpreted together with the explicit applicability/swappable_stages contract; isolated descriptions overstated the mandatory feature set in the previous readiness audit.
Do not claim implementation of omitted holiday, promotion or embedding branches. Cross-domain reuse requires the selected feature and observation-availability assumptions.

Clipping does not by itself replicate a competition evaluation metric. The realization declares its squared-error objective and clipped-prediction RMSE; no historical metric or accuracy equivalence is certified.
All configured trials and feature operations remain mandatory. This resolution does not approve providers, stored execution or the original CDG.
Automated Tier 3 semantic qualification only; provider intake/publication and corrected original CDG approval remain separate pending actions.
Nearby candidate review is bounded to the named implementations; it is not an exhaustive proof that no equivalent implementation exists anywhere in the catalog.
Numeric lags, grouping means, bounds and model inputs are reusable. Root parsing, event role names and three-category assembly retain explicit recipe assumptions.

Fixed entity population and zero absence, one unknown final period, and rolling one-step validation availability are required. Hyperparameter-selection scores are not unbiased generalization estimates.
Complete synthetic computation and unchanged reference parity do not establish historical winning accuracy, source-data equivalence, clean deployment or fitted-weight provenance.
Installed files match their own RECORD hashes; independent package publisher authentication is not established.
Selection and feature checks validate structure, not same-invocation provenance; callers must preserve their bindings.
Complete stored nine-node graph through the production converter and native runner; original approval remains pending.
Three synthetic cases exercise every configured feature window, trial, early stopping and final refit; reference equality does not certify historical accuracy or cross-domain generalization.
qualification.parameter_contract: Validate the finite JSON root and expose independent populations and recipe controls. Inputs: payload: Exact version/transactions/entities/boundaries/feature_controls/training_controls dictionary. Version is Python integer one excluding bool. Feature controls have exactly lags, rolling_windows, calendar_cycle and cold_start; training controls are a dictionary. Bounds: Require strict finite JSON serialization, deep-copy input, and finite Python int/float cold_start in [0,20] excluding bool. Detailed population, offset, chronology and training validation occurs downstream. No hidden feature construction or training occurs in this stage. Compensated signed transaction summation within caller-defined periods and entity slots. Inputs: transactions: List of exact day/store/item/quantity dictionaries; integer positions and finite Python numeric quantities excluding bool.; entities: Nonempty list of exact store/item/category dictionaries with Python integer slots in [0,2**31), unique store/item pairs and one category per item.; boundaries: At least four strictly increasing Python integer boundaries excluding bool; the last interval is the unobserved forecast period. Bounds: Transactions must lie inside observed periods and the explicit entity universe. Missing observed-period transactions mean zero. Group all quantities before math.fsum; preserve negative returns and reject nonfinite sums. No clipping occurs. Caller declares every entity active in every period. Entity order is preserved. Clip observed numeric totals and append one unknown future row. Inputs: totals: Nonempty finite rank-two float64 observed panel.; lower: Finite Python int/float lower bound excluding bool.; upper: Finite Python int/float upper bound greater than lower, excluding bool. Bounds: Return a fresh array using np.clip without truncation, rounding or imputation; append exactly one all-NaN row. The lower and upper bounds are independent inputs. No aggregation or model fitting occurs. Construct prior-only lags and full-width rolling means through an external rolling callable. Inputs: targets: Rank-two float64 panel with at least one finite observed row and exactly one final all-NaN row.; lags: Nonempty list of unique positive Python integer offsets excluding bool.; rolling_windows: Nonempty list of unique positive Python integer widths excluding bool.; rolling_function: Externally bound rolling_statistics(values,window_size,agg_fns); must return aligned finite float64 (observed rows,1) means. Bounds: Invoke the supplied rolling provider on a copy of each observed entity series for every requested width, with agg_fns=[mean]. Shift its current-inclusive results by one period and mask incomplete initial windows. Preserve configured order and NaN missing offsets. Output validation cannot authenticate an arbitrary callable; qualified graph binds the exact reviewed rolling atom. Build prior-only expanding numeric group means and explicit cyclic period features. Inputs: targets: Finite observed float64 numeric panel with exactly one final unknown row.; groups: Aligned nonnegative int64 entity-by-group-column matrix; any positive number of grouping columns.; calendar_cycle: Positive Python integer cycle length excluding bool.; cold_start: Finite Python int/float initial mean excluding bool. Bounds: For each period use only earlier observed rows. Preserve entity mean, one mean for each group partition, and global mean using the retained NumPy reduction order. At the first period use the explicit cold-start mean. Include grouping values, period index and sine/cosine. Reject nonfinite output. Group codes are converted to float64 features and integers above exact float64 precision are not guaranteed distinct. Apply the retained three-category recipe layout to separately computed feature blocks. Inputs: targets: Float64 observed/future panel with one unknown last row.; lagged: Aligned float64 lag and rolling block; NaN is allowed, infinity rejected.; encoded: Aligned finite float64 block of exactly eleven columns from the three-group encoding recipe.; lags: Configured lag labels in the same order as the supplied block.; rolling_windows: Configured rolling labels in the same order as the supplied block. Bounds: Validate block shapes, arrange the first six encoding columns before lags/rolling and the final five means after them, and attach period ids and feature labels. Does not authenticate same-invocation feature provenance or independently recompute means. This stage is the explicit three-category recipe boundary. Complete isolated numeric TPE search with early stopping and explicit category and prediction-bound policy. Inputs: panel: Panel of nonempty float64 features without infinity, finite observed targets, final unknown targets, complete rectangular int64 period ids and unique feature labels.; config: Exact train_start, validation_start, trials, startup_trials, max_rounds, stopping_rounds, seed and bounded search_space for num_leaves/min_data_in_leaf/learning_rate.; categorical_columns: Distinct in-range integer column positions; selected values must be finite nonnegative int32-compatible integers. Empty list is allowed.; lower: Finite Python numeric prediction lower bound excluding bool.; upper: Finite Python numeric prediction upper bound greater than lower, excluding bool. Bounds: Fresh same-interpreter worker through strict finite JSON pipes, with unknown numeric values encoded as null. Enforce one-thread native pools, one-thread LightGBM and one Optuna job. Require ordered nonempty train/validation/final periods, at least two training and validation rows, model-based trials beyond startup, valid early stopping, seed in [0,2**32), and finite nondegenerate positive search ranges. Train every requested trial using deterministic squared-error LightGBM and clipped-prediction RMSE. Do not refit on the combined observed population here. Timeout is positive finite SCIONA_FUTURE_SALES_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, default 3600 seconds. Failures and captured diagnostics are reported generically. No payload files are used. One isolated final fit with the selected parameters and boosting rounds, then forecast the final period. Inputs: panel: Same compatible numeric panel used for selection.; config: Same explicit complete training configuration used for selection.; categorical_columns: Same explicit categorical positions used for selection.; lower: Same finite prediction lower bound used for selection.; upper: Same finite prediction upper bound used for selection.; selection: Exact search result with bounded selected parameters, ordered complete trial history, best recorded trial/rounds and matching population counts. Bounds: Repeat numerical input validation and verify selection structure, search bounds, first-minimum trial and matching row counts. Fit exactly once using all observed rows from train_start, at selected_rounds; no new search. Forecast exactly the last period, preserve entity order and clip to the supplied bounds. Use fresh worker and finite JSON transport as search. Structural checks do not authenticate that parameters, scores and features originated from the same invocation; caller provenance remains required.
